title: Morning deploy playbook scratchpad
content:
Quick morning scratchpad for Site A (El Paso) private deployment. Use this as my running checklist/notes, not a polished runbook.

Goals today:
- Finish host prep (nodes 1-3).
- Confirm VPC peering + customer firewall egress for model registry.
- Get TLS certs installed and test a full inference request through LB.

Top-of-head checklist (order I usually run):
1) Console access: confirm SSH to jumpbox (jump-elpaso.redwood.local) => ssh aisha@10.10.8.12. If fails, check serial console with vendor portal.
2) NTP & time skew: timedatectl status -> make sure synced to pool.ntp.org (customer wants internal NTP 10.0.1.5).
3) Disk layout: confirm /var/lib/redwood on LVM (vg_redwood/lv_data) and available >= 2TB. df -h /var/lib/redwood.
4) GPU driver + CUDA: nvidia-smi (expect driver 535.x, GPUs: A100s). If missing, use vendor image provided or install driver package via apt.
5) Container runtime: docker 24.0 or containerd running. systemctl status containerd.
6) Kernel params: vm.swappiness=10, net.core.somaxconn=1024. sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-redwood.conf.
7) Ports to allow outbound: 443 (model registry + CDN), 50051 (gRPC to control plane), 27017 (internal monitoring, only from mgmt subnet). Inbound: 443/80 for LB health checks, 9000 (internal admin).

Customer-specific env reminders (callouts):
- Customer NAT egress is through a Palo Alto on 203.0.113.18; they block unknown HTTPS SNI. Add model-registry.redwood.ai and artifact-cdn.redwood.ai to allowed SNI list.
- They've asked to pin KMS key alias: alias/redwood/elpaso. Make sure keys/role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-deploy exists.
- VLAN tagging: host NICs must be untagged on mgmt VLAN 10 and tagged on GPU VLAN 110. Bring interface up with: ip link add link eth1 name eth1.110 type vlan id 110; ip link set eth1.110 up.

Preflight commands I ran this morning (notes & outputs):
- ssh to jumpbox: connected (latency 42ms)
- sudo parted -l -> disks okay, root on nvme0n1p2
- nvidia-smi shows 3x A100 80GB, temps normal.
- docker ps -> containerd picked up runtime. Redwood base image v2.5.3 pulled (sha256:abcd...).

Open blockers and mitigations:
- Blocker: Customer FW blocking egress to S3 endpoint for our model blobs.
  - Mitigation: asked customer to whitelist s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com (ticket PD-4221). If they refuse, mirror minimal model artifacts to customer-provided blobstore (they offered MinIO at https://10.0.2.7:9000). Need access creds from Carlos.
- Blocker: Missing service account with IAM role for kms:Encrypt on alias/redwood/elpaso.
  - Mitigation: Priya is creating role; ETA = EOD today. Workaround: temporarily use local encrypted volume + manual key transfer (risk: operational overhead).
- Blocker: Console cable for rack 3 is damaged (can't access iDRAC).
  - Mitigation: vendor scheduled replacement at 17:00; using jumpbox remote for now.

Quick tweaky reminders (notes to self):
- If model load fails with OOM on node-2, try quantized variant (q4_0) and lower batch to 1. Set REDWOOD_MAX_BATCH=1 in env.
- Watch for KV cache thrashing: if tail latency spikes, enable prefix-cache route on the router conf (/etc/redwood/router.conf) -> prefix_cache.enabled=true
- For long installs, run nohup redwood-deploy --background & and capture logs to /var/log/redwood/deploy-<ts>.log.

Testing & verification plan (smoke tests):
- LB health -> curl -v https://elpaso-rdwd-lb.internal/health -> expect 200 & JSON {"status":"ok"}
- Simple generation: curl -X POST https://elpaso-proxy.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -> expect 200 & tokens > 0
- Latency smoke: run 5 concurrent reqs, 95th pct < 120ms (on dedicated lane).
- Cert validation: openssl s_client -connect elpaso-rdwd-lb.internal:443 -servername elpaso.redwood.ai -> check certificate chain and SANs include elpaso.redwood.ai and internal alias.

Handoff note for night shift (concise):
- If Priya's IAM role not present by 19:00, stop further automatic deployments and switch to manual artifact copy (see section above).
- If LB returns 502 for > 10 mins, rollback to last working image v2.5.1 (GH tag). Command: redwood-ctl rollback --tag v2.5.1
- Sleepy vendor: if serial console still dead, escalate to vendor on-call: +1-800-555-0132 -> ticket with subject 'iDRAC console replacement - rack 3'

Loose TODOs (personal):
- 1) Update official runbook with Palo Alto SNI steps (ref PD-4221).
- 2) Add script to verify NTP + cert chain in one go (small bash snippet).
- 3) Ask infra to bake an image with containerd & driver preinstalled for this customer image variant.

Random quick commands I often forget (save here):
- Check kernel rings: ethtool -S eth1 | grep tx_errors
- Check GPU memory usage per process: nvidia-smi pmon -c 1
- Dump active iptables nat table: sudo iptables -t nat -L -n -v

Notes to follow up in ticket / messages:
- Carlos: need MinIO creds or permission to upload mirror.
- Priya: confirm IAM role + attach kms:Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyPerms.
- Customer: confirm when they will whitelist model-registry.redwood.ai SNI (otherwise we will mirror).

End-of-day short log:
- 08:15 - Arrived, bumped into Jorge from vendor; confirmed new racked GPU units.
- 09:02 - Jumpbox validated, started driver install on node-3.
- 11:40 - Hit S3 egress block, opened PD-4221.
- 13:30 - Lunch, left remote checks running.
- 15:10 - Driver install done; container images pulled, started redwood services on nodes 1-2. node-3 still pending (console cable).
- 16:45 - Ran basic inference smoke, got 200 but tail latency 320ms on one node -> probably cache miss + busy IO.

If anything is extremely unclear, flag it in Slack #private-deploys and tag me (@aisha).

-- aisha
